blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C2):** eu consigo ler, ouvir, falar e escrever sobre ciência e reconhecimento a partir de uma biografia, mantendo precisão histórica e linguagem avaliativa cautelosa.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Rosalind Franklin (1920–1958)
paras: Rosalind Franklin was an English chemist and X-ray crystallographer. At King’s College London in the early 1950s she produced **exceptionally clear X-ray diffraction images** of DNA fibres. Her measurements **helped establish** the helical structure and the position of the phosphate backbone, **data on which** James Watson and Francis Crick **drew** for their 1953 model.

She died of cancer in 1958, aged 37. The Nobel Prize of 1962 went to Watson, Crick and Maurice Wilkins; it **cannot be awarded** posthumously. **Historians continue to debate** how fully her role was credited, and **many now regard** her contribution as essential.

items.q: Franklin produced clear X-ray images of DNA.
The Nobel Prize is awarded posthumously.
Historians agree entirely on how she was credited.

blocks.body: Em biografias de cientistas, atribua **contribuições com verbos precisos** e registre **o debate** sem tomar partido infundado. **Relativa formal**: preposição + *which*.
Não atribua intenções às pessoas sem fonte; relate o que os documentos mostram.

items.s: Her data helped ___ the helical structure. (establish)
Data on ___ Watson and Crick drew. (which)

body: **Give credit where credit is due.** — Dar crédito a quem merece.
**Unsung hero.** — Herói anônimo.
**Pave the way.** — Abrir caminho.
**Ahead of her time.** — À frente do seu tempo.
**In the shadow of.** — À sombra de.
**Set the record straight.** — Corrigir o registro.
**Come to light.** — Vir à tona.
**Leave a mark.** — Deixar marca.
**Stand on the shoulders of giants.** — Apoiar-se nos ombros de gigantes.
**A pioneer in her field.** — Pioneira em sua área.
**What was her key contribution?** — Qual foi sua contribuição principal?
**Very clear X-ray images of DNA fibres.** — Imagens de raios X muito claras de fibras de DNA.
**Was she awarded the Nobel Prize?** — Ela recebeu o Nobel?

items.note: Ritmo e ênfase para nuances: o acento muda o sentido (He said she STOLE it × he said SHE stole it) e as pausas separam ideias técnicas densas.

blocks.task: Write a 6-sentence biographical paragraph about a scientist with precise dates, contribution verbs and one cautious statement.
blocks.model: Rosalind Franklin was born in London in 1920. In the early 1950s she produced exceptionally clear X-ray images of DNA. Her measurements helped establish the helical structure, data on which later models drew. She died in 1958, aged 37. Historians continue to debate how fully her role was credited. Many now regard her contribution as essential.
